answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the velvet queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1495 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the plume. A 474 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
